decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box was launched in 2024 and suits the firm's utility customers, its prospects are still uncertain, and a made-to-order fabricated item costs little to keep listed, so the option should stay open.
Public waste bins use the firm's steel and coating skills and reach public-sector buyers, there is no evidence yet against their value, and keeping them costs little.
Ground sleeves for posts are a cheap complementary option tied to the waste bin and street furniture business, and one year of website presence reveals too little to justify abandoning them.
The cast iron sleeve variant overlaps with the other sleeve products, which makes it a somewhat likelier candidate for consolidation, but it is still too early and too cheap to keep to drop it.
Steel ground sleeves fit the firm's core steel processing expertise and cost little to keep on offer while demand uncertainty resolves.
